$$\frac{g(a)-g(1)}{a-1}=\frac{g(a)g(1)}{g(a)}$$
$$\frac{g(a)-1}{a-1}=\frac{g(a)}{g(a)} = 1$$
$$g(a) - 1 = a - 1 \implies g(a) = a.$$
This implies that $g(x)=x$ whenever $g(x) \neq 0$ and $x \neq 1$.
